methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $105M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
EarthGrid is a seed-stage transportation company that has raised $105.3M to date. The broader Transportation sector comp universe includes 6 private peers (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Navier, Olympian Motors) and no public comparables, limiting direct peer benchmarking.

Stage-Progression methodology is applicable and produces the primary valuation signal. Using total capital raised ($105M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields $263M. Peer-Median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within Transportation; the broader peer set exists but does not meet the three-datapoint minimum for narrow-filter reliability, making sector-wide median application counterproductive.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $224M (low) to $303M (median $263M), anchored primarily to Stage-Progression. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at the same stage and capitalization profile, limiting cross-validation of the step-up multiple; the reliance on raised capital as a current-value proxy absent disclosed recent financials; and the early-stage nature of the round, which typically carries wide outcome distributions. The single-method result should be treated as directional rather than definitive pending additional data or market signals.
